clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements for synthetic resin adhesives suitable for wood work (non-structural) and joinery.

clauses.title: Types – Synthetic resin
clauses.text: 2. Types - Synthetic resin adhesives for wood shall be of the following four types : Boiling Water Proof BWP Boiling Water Resistance BWR Warm  Water  Resistance WWR Cold    Water  Resistance CWR 2.1 Gap filling and close contact adhesives  of four types shall have following symbols : SUMMARY OF IS 851 : 1978 SYNTHETIC RESIN ADHESIVES FOR CONSTRUCTION WORK (NON-STRUCTURAL) IN WOOD (First Revision) Type Symbol Gap -Filling        Close Contact Adhesive               Adhesive Boiling Water  Proof BWP/GF BWP/CC Boiling Water  Resistance BWR/GF BWR/CC Warm Water  Resistance WWR/GF WWR/CC Cold Water  Resistance CWR/GF BWP/CC

clauses.title: Keeping Properties
clauses.text: 3. clauses.title: Gap Joints
clauses.text: 5.1 Gap Joints— Average failing load shall not be less than 180 kg for all   types.
